question.html:
A student drops a solid sphere and a solid cylinder, both with identical mass and radius, from rest at the top of an incline. Assuming rolling without slipping and no air resistance, which object reaches the bottom first, and why?

Object reaching bottom firstReason
ASphereSmaller moment of inertia
BCylinderGreater rotational energy
CSphereGreater translational energy
DCylinderLower rotational speed
